correctness.rationale: For rank-m square-zero X, image equals kernel, so X has one GL(2m)-orbit with exactly [2m choose m]_q |GL_m| elements. Commuting Y is precisely [[A,B],[0,A]]. Conditions Y²=0 give A²=0 and AB+BA=0, rankXY=rankA=r. For A rank r, choose image I, kernel K, and V/K-to-I isomorphism in [m choose r]_q [m-r choose r]_q |GL_r| ways. In adapted r,h,r blocks B has [[P,Q,R],[0,S,T],[0,0,-P]] and rankY=2r+rankS. Thus rankY=m iff S∈GL_h and there are q^{2r(m-r)} |GL_h| Bs per A, valid in char2 too. All r<=floor(m/2) occur. Direct finite brute checks m<=4, q in {2,3,4,5}, including GF4, support; finite checks do not certify all cases.

value.rationale: The invariant rankXY measures the quadratic radical action in modules over F_q[x,y]/(x²,y²), separating the nonzero-product locus from mutually annihilating pairs. On the whole natural maximal-rank commuting square-zero stratum, the result determines all possible product ranks, sharp dimension bound, and exact finite-field point counts for every q and m. The explicit all-dimensional positive-product distribution is a complete motivated invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a recomputation of the r=0 case.
